description:
Former Vice President Al Gore sits down with "Inside Politics" anchor Dana Bash for a wide-ranging interview touching on the Trump-Xi-Putin summit meeting, tech policy, and more. Gore speaks climate change on the 20th anniversary of his film “An Inconvenient Truth,” which catapulted the issue into the public consciousness. He says there is reason to hope that humanity will win the fight against climate change, but the one big question left is “will we win it in time to avoid some of the truly catastrophic changes to the Earth’s systems that would be so harmful to humanity.”

Also, Gore says it is still to be determined whether AI will be a net positive or negative for humanity, but the answer to that question depends on what we do now. “We need to regulate these pioneer models. We need to protect the American people and humanity from some of the dire consequences that Dario [Amodei] and other have warned us about.” Gore advised Apple and Google after leaving office.

0:00 Former Vice
